The '''Sprite subspace transmitter''' was a model of [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace transceiver]] manufactured by [[Chedak Communications]]. The device was used to broadcast [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signals]] to a range of twenty-five [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]]. The Sprite was used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] aboard their [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="EGWT" />
